english.title: Take a child so as to remove him / her from a person having lawful control
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, took **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a child under the age of 16 so as to remove

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

from the lawful control of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person having lawful control of the child
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(1)(a) and 4 of the Child Abduction Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See also the associated offence wording as follows:
H1650 - where the child is detained from a person having lawful control.
(ii) See similar offence wordings: H2067 and H2075 where the child is taken/detained
from a person entitled to lawful control.
(iii) See other offence wordings: H2066, H2073, H2286, H2296, H2297, H2299 and H2300 where the child is taken/detained from a person entitled to lawful custody, taken/sent out of UK by a parent, taken/kept while in care or incited to run away.
(iv) See section 2(2) for persons to whom this offence does not apply.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
